title: Early 3D Modeling
description: My interest in 3D graphics started in high school and continued through college, where I used tools such as 3D Studio 4 and later 3ds Max to learn modeling, animation, and the basics of creating game-oriented 3D artwork.

sections.title: Early 3D Learning
paragraphs: This work represents my early experimentation with 3D modeling and animation before I began using those skills directly in later game projects. I created models and animations primarily as a way to learn the tools and understand how 3D assets were constructed.

historicalNotes: This work was primarily personal learning and experimentation from high school through college.
It predates Jamie's later production use of 3D modeling in H-0P3, Santa's Route 3D, and Bridge Captain.
3D Studio 4 was used during the DOS era, followed later by 3ds Max on Windows.
